title: Default Struct Values
goal: Initialize struct fields using Default and update syntax.

source.attribution: adapted from Day 4 Afternoon: Standard Traits

hints: Struct update syntax uses two dots followed by an expression that produces a default struct instance.
Default can be called directly as an associated function on the type.
explanation: `..Default::default()` creates a default instance of `Config` and fills in remaining unspecified fields. `Config::default()` constructs a full struct with all default values. Using `..Config` fails with `E0423` because `Config` is a type name, not an instance value. Using `{}` without fields causes `E0063` because required fields are missing.
